item.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine awaits White House sign-off on US drone production deal

item.title: Drone strike hits school and medical center in Sudan, killing 17, mostly schoolgirls
item.summary: An explosive-laden drone blamed on Sudanese paramilitaries has struck a secondary school and a health care center in southern Sudan, killing at least 17 people, mostly schoolgirls, a hospital official and a medical group said

item.title: At least 50 people killed and 125 others reported missing after Ethiopia landslides
item.summary: An official says at least 50 people have died and 125 others are missing after landslides hit three districts in southern Ethiopia following a week of heavy rains
